issue.title: Align Spark model completion description casing
issue.description: Discovered in an unrelated full-suite verification run. tests/test_xprompt_model_completion.py::test_model_completion_catalog_reflects_real_builtin_model_metadata fails reproducibly in isolation: the current catalog description is 'codex (gpt53spark)' while the test expects 'Codex (gpt53spark)'. Decide the intended provider display casing and align the registry/catalog implementation and assertion.

payload.entry: Implemented explicit human-facing provider display_name metadata while preserving lowercase routing identity, and made the model completion catalog prefer that display label with backward-compatible fallbacks. Verified 27 focused registry/completion tests pass, including Spark description Codex (gpt53spark); formatting, Ruff, mypy, pyscripts, changelog, toobig, SASE validation, and committed-plan validation pass; full tests passed 24,775 non-visual tests with 7 skips. just check remains blocked only by pre-existing Symvision failure tracked in ready bead sase-c3, and 53 recurring unrelated visual baseline mismatches are tracked in ready bead sase-c6.
Follow-up triage: sase-c3 was canceled as a duplicate of canonical in-progress bead sase-c1, which tracks the same pre-existing Symvision failure.

Finalizer verification confirmed the bead is closed; 27 focused registry/completion tests passed, all 24,775 non-visual tests passed, and only independently tracked pre-existing Symvision and visual snapshot failures blocked the full check.
